changes.comment: Support linting HTML when paired with the `@html-eslint/eslint-plugin` language plugin. Element text and `<!-- -->` comment bodies are checked like comments; prose attribute values (`alt`, `title`, `aria-*`) like strings (auto-fixed); and identifier attributes (`class`, `id`, `name`, `for`, ...) like identifiers (report-only). Tag names, URLs and `data-*` values are left alone.
